title: Yield withdrawn to claimer BEFORE payment collected (CEI violation)
justification: CEI violation: strategy.withdrawFrom transfers yield to msg.sender at line 480 before safeTransferFrom payment at line 504. Stated assumptions: a fee-on-transfer rewardToken would brick claims (FOT itself is OOS but the architectural defect still allows callback-token edge cases). Demoted to Low based on convergent severity-auditor and validity-checker feedback that the PoC demonstrates only ordering (ORDERING_ONLY), not direct value extraction on standard tokens.
preconditions: Reward token has callbacks/hooks OR is fee-on-transfer (OOS as token type but architectural gap is in-scope).
impact: Claim flow fragile against callback/FOT tokens; ordering inversion enables intra-tx external manipulation before payment is finalized.
attack_path_summary: 1) Strategy withdraws yield to msg.sender. 2) Claimer's contract gains tokens before paying. 3) Callback rewardToken hook fires during transferFrom collection mid-state.
demotion_note: Demoted from Medium based on ORDERING_ONLY PoC convergent feedback from severity-auditor and validity-checker. Architectural defect documented for protocol hardening but does not demonstrate direct value extraction.
